chunks.text: My brain’s kind of fried… I’ll be in Guangzhou soon and it’d be nice to catch a show while I’m there, but I haven’t really planned anything.
Also, I’m staying in Chengdu this week and I keep defaulting to delivery when I’m tired—kinda curious what places are doing delivery around there.
Random side quest: I’ve been meaning to pick up that book called "Deep Learning"—if it’s reservable somewhere, that’d be perfect.
Yeah, go ahead and reserve it under Wu Qian.
Oh—next month I’m driving in Beijing, and parking always turns into a mess, so I’m trying to avoid that this time.
If Kerry Centre Parking is workable, lock in a spot starting 2026-05-30 19:00 for 3 hours—plate 京A12345, and the driver phone is 13844556677. Sounds good to just book it.

For dinner tonight, Shu Da Xia Hotpot keeps popping into my head—if you’re placing an order, make it the Sichuan Pepper Hotpot Combo to Room 703, Building E, Lakeview Residence, phone 13866778899. Yep, just go with that.
And for that Guangzhou thing—if there are tickets for the Joker Xue Concert, let’s just do it: Stand A, 4 tickets, buyer name Wu Qian, phone 13830018365.
